title: The share-links feature let any user with add_sharelink create a public link to any document, including ones they could not view.

findings.explanation: The diff introduces a new Django model (ShareLink), a migration, an admin class, a filter set, and a serializer. All database interactions are handled by the Django ORM (e.g., `models.ForeignKey`, `FilterSet`, `admin.site.register`). There is no raw SQL execution or string concatenation of user input into SQL queries in the provided code.

The new `ShareLinkSerializer` inherits from `OwnedObjectSerializer`. In the Paperless-ngx codebase (which this diff belongs to), `OwnedObjectSerializer` enforces that the `owner` field is set to the currently authenticated user during creation and restricts queryset access to objects owned by the user. The migration also explicitly grants `sharelink` permissions to users/groups who have `add_document` permission, aligning with the application's permission model. The admin interface uses `GuardedModelAdmin`, which restricts access to superusers or users with specific permissions. No IDOR or missing authorization checks are evident in the provided diff.
